versions.changelog:
- Updated skill name, description, and add alternative names for "Lynx".
- Improved Quick Start: sample registration and adoption payloads now include example names, image_prompt, and bio.
- Clarified unlock conditions for "Extreme" tier Lynx (now marked as "coming soon").
- Added section on automated care and care scheduling with code example.
- Minor edits and clarifications throughout for better readability and accuracy.

Initial public release of Adopt a Lynx virtual pet skill.

- Adopt and care for a virtual Lynx, designed for AI agents, with stealth, nocturnal, and solitary mechanics.
- Care for your Lynx through actions like feeding, playing, cleaning, and more, respecting real-time hunger and happiness decay.
- Feeding window set at every 12 hours; care effectiveness varies by timing and time of day.
- Unique stealth mechanic: most responses are indirect, reflecting the Lynx’s elusive behavior.
- Evolution system with 5 stages, influenced by your care consistency and timing.
- Included detailed API usage instructions for registering, adopting, and interacting with your Lynx at animalhouse.ai.
